displayName: Orshot Social Media Content Generator: design Instagram post, LinkedIn post, TikTok, story, ad and carousel templates on brand
description: Social media content generator and social media design for AI agents. Create on-brand Instagram post, LinkedIn post, TikTok, Reels, story, ad, banner, thumbnail and carousel templates with Orshot, then render them with new copy on every post. Content creation for Instagram, LinkedIn, TikTok, X, Facebook, YouTube and Pinterest, a Canva alternative an agent can drive, with craft rules (hierarchy, 2 fonts, 60-30-10 color), brand kit first and a render-and-critique loop over the Orshot MCP server.
